## Ryan Suchala — Guest Research Brief (First United Bank)

**Confirmed title:** Executive Vice President and Chief Banking Officer, First United Bank & Trust Company. Promoted to this role March 24, 2025.
Sources: [Bankers Digest, promotion announcement](https://bankersdigest.com/oklahoma-based-first-united-bank-promotes-suchala-to-chief-banking-officer/), [ZoomInfo profile](https://www.zoominfo.com/p/Ryan-Suchala/1348553333), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryansuchala/) (title corroborated in search snippet; profile itself returned 403 on direct fetch, so treat as secondary confirmation), [First United Bank bio page](https://www.firstunitedbank.com/ryan-suchala) (page exists per search results but returned 403 on direct fetch — could not independently verify content, only that Google indexes it under his name).

**Professional accomplishments**
- Nearly 20 years of banking experience; promoted to Chief Banking Officer overseeing strategy, customer engagement, and growth initiatives across Texas and Oklahoma. Source: [Bankers Digest](https://bankersdigest.com/oklahoma-based-first-united-bank-promotes-suchala-to-chief-banking-officer/)
- Named to D Magazine/D CEO's "Dallas 500" list of most powerful Dallas business leaders for 2022. Source: [Bankers Digest](https://bankersdigest.com/first-united-banks-suchala-named-among-d-magazine-d-ceos-dallas-500-list-for-2022/)
- Prior career: 17 years at BOK Financial, most recently as Dallas/Bank of Texas market president (Bank of Texas is a BOK Financial subsidiary), before joining First United Bank roughly seven-plus years ago as DFW Regional President. Source: [Bankers Digest](https://bankersdigest.com/oklahoma-based-first-united-bank-promotes-suchala-to-chief-banking-officer/)
- Education: BBA and MBA in Finance from University of Oklahoma's Michael F. Price College of Business; completed Southwestern Graduate School of Banking at SMU and the Stagen Leadership Institute's Integral Leadership Program. Sources: search-indexed content citing Bankers Digest/D Magazine profiles.
